site.title: {project} - Ukwabelana Ngeefayile Okungenamhlaba
site.description: {project} yisoftware yokwabelana ngeefayile ye-peer-to-peer eyakhiwe kubuchwepheshe banamhlanje obungenamhlaba.
site.ogDescription: Ukwabelana ngeefayile kwe-peer-to-peer okwakhiwe kubuchwepheshe banamhlanje obungenamhlaba. Akukho ziseva eziphakathi. Akukho ndawo inye yokusilela.

hero.subtitle: Isizukulwana esilandelayo sokwabelana ngeefayile kwi-peer-to-peer
hero.description: Yakhiwe kubuchwepheshe banamhlanje obungenamhlaba. Akukho ziseva eziphakathi. Akukho ndawo inye yokusilela.

about.title: Malunga
about.intro: {project} yiqonga lokwabelana ngeefayile kwi-peer-to-peer lesizukulwana esilandelayo elakhiwe kubuchwepheshe banamhlanje obungenamhlaba. Lihlanganisa ujongano lomsebenzisi olucacileyo nemveliso engenamhlaba ngokupheleleyo, lubonelela ngesisombululo esikhuselekileyo nesithembekileyo sokwabelana ngedatha ngokuzimeleyo kuwo nawuphi na umgaqo ophambili. Iprojekthi yi-open source kwaye isasazwa phantsi {license}.

decentralized.title: Uthungelwano olungenamhlaba ngokupheleleyo
decentralized.description: Akukho ziseva eziphakathi, akukho ndawo inye yokusilela. Abasebenzisi bafuna baze bakhuphele umxholo ngqo phakathi kwabo, ngaphandle kokuxhomekeka kwiindawo zokugcina, ababukeli okanye iidatabase eziphakathi.

accessControl.title: Ulawulo lokufikelela olucacileyo
accessControl.description: Wonke umntu ukhululekile ukuqala uthungelwano lwakhe namalungelo akhe. Chaza iindima zomsebenzisi kuwo wonke uthungelwano: abanini, abalawuli, abapapashi, abalawuli kunye nabakhuphelayo. Lawula ngokuchanekileyo ukuba ngubani onokupapasha, alawule, kwaye akhuphele umxholo.

ui.title: Ujongano lomsebenzisi olubalaseleyo
ui.description: Ujongano lwe-media center olucacileyo nolulula kumsebenzisi olwenzelwe iiplatform zedeskthophu, iTV neemobhayile. Hamba ngokungenazingxaki ngekhibhodi, impuku, igamepad okanye ulawulo olukude. Abasebenzisi abakwaziyo banokusebenzisa ujongano lwe-command line ukuqhuba isoftware njengeseva yefayile engenantloko.

dataFormat.title: Ifomathi yedatha efundeka ngabantu
dataFormat.description: Ifomathi yedatha ye-LISH isekelwe kwi-JSON, ekwenza kube lula ukudala, ukufunda nokuqonda. Yabelana ngomxholo wakho ngemetadata ecacileyo, ekhanyayo enokuphengululwa lula ngubani na.

security.title: Ubumfihlo nokhuseleko
security.description: Lonke unxibelelwano lwe-peer-to-peer luyabethelwa, luqinisekisa ukuba idatha yakho ihlala iyimfihlo ngexesha lokudluliswa. Abasebenzisi bangabhaca emva kwe-VPN ukufumana umaleko ongezelelweyo wokungaziwa. {project} ihlonipha ubumfihlo bakho ngoyilo.

crossPlatform.title: Iiplatform ezahlukeneyo
crossPlatform.description: Isoftware iyafumaneka kwiiplatform ze-Windows, Linux ne-macOS. Yisebenzise kuso nasiphi na isixhobo osikhethileyo.

download.title: Khuphela
download.description: Fumana {project} kwiplatform yakho. Konke ukukhuphela kusimahla kwaye kuyi-open source.

macos.title: Inqaku elibalulekileyo kubasebenzisi be-macOS:
macos.intro: I-macOS Gatekeeper ivimba iiapps ezingatyikitywanga / ezingavakaliswanga ezikhutshelwe kwi-intanethi ngempazamo {error}.
macos.runCommand: Emva kokukhuphela i-DMG okanye i-ZIP, qhuba umyalelo kwi-Terminal ngolu hlobo lulandelayo phambi kokuvula i-app:
macos.explanation: Oku kususa uphawu lwe-quarantine kwaye kuvumela i-app ukuba isebenze.
